about: Soak Squad, the kit's example (examples/minimal/soak-squad), with a look target measured from its own look: its four sheet framings (wide, hero, props, the HUD view) rendered on the graphics card, pooled through builder/look/stats.mjs (2026-10-14). The target rests on frames (from: refs) whose files are not here: measure 23 holds the game to the numbers the target carries. Written for this kit; no upstream code, no reference art.
